## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Mixed-case writes should be fixed because the new setter stores keys that the getter cannot retrieve.

## Changes
The pull request adds `Cache.set`, raises the default TTL to 300 seconds, and adds round-trip and expiry tests. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cache.py:27 — correctness — Normalize keys before storing cache entries — After `set("ALPHA", 1)`, both `get("alpha")` and `get("ALPHA")` return `None`. You store the original key, while `get` always looks up `key.lower()`, violating the documented case-insensitive contract. — Callers writing mixed-case keys cannot retrieve their cached values, and mixed-case updates leave existing lowercase entries unchanged.
